āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati||61||
tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭhamuśanti tat||3||
sidhmaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdhamantarghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret||21||
pūrvaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kākaṇantīphalopamam||30||
kuṣṭhaikasambhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca tat||37||
caran srotaḥsu rikteṣu bhṛśaṃ tānyeva pūrayan||6||
rakte tīvrā rujaḥ svāpaṃ tāpaṃ rāgaṃ vivarṇatām||10||
yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho+abhyeti muhurmuhuḥ||16||
nāḍīḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan||18||
sa eva cāpatānākhyo mukte tu marutā hṛdi||20||
antardhanurivāṅgaṃ ca vegaiḥ stambhaṃ ca netrayoḥ||23||
bāhyāyāmaṃ dhanuṣkambhaṃ bruvate veginaṃ ca tam||26||
kampate gamanārambhe khañjanniva ca yāti yaḥ||46||
ruk pāde viṣamanyaste śramādvā jāyate yadā||53||
hṛṣyete caraṇau yasya bhavetāṃ ca prasuptavat||55||
ākhoriva viṣaṃ kruddhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dehaṃ vidhāvati||8||
karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataścaran||11||
pitte vidāhaḥ sammohaḥ svedo mūrcchā madaḥ satṛṭ||15||
harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca sañcāra iva jāyate||35||
calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho gātreṣvarocakaḥ||35||
āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasā+a+avṛte||36||
śūlaṃ ca pīḍyamānena pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham||38||
śukrāvṛte+ativego vā na vā niṣphalatā+api vā||38||
annāvṛte vāte bhukte sati rujā kukṣau bhavati| jīrṇe+anne sati rujā śāmyati|
vrajatyāśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ||40||
bhramo mūrcchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte||42||
gurutā+aṅgeṣu sarveṣu skhalitaṃ ca gatau bhṛśam||48||
sthānānyavekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇāt||53||
āvṛtā vāyavo+ajñātā jñātā vā vatsaraṃ sthitāḥ||57||
āmāśayastho hatvā+agniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāya yat||1||
prāgūpeṣu jvarādau vā, balaṃ yatnena pālayan||2||
laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte+agnau lāghave sati||3||
śītaṃ tebhyo hitaṃ toyaṃ pācanaṃ tṛḍjvarāpaham||16||
ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā||16||
ajīrṇa iva śūlaghnaṃ sāme tīvraruji jvare||18||

sa-malānāṃ-sāmānāṃ vātādīnāṃ pṛthaksthitānāṃ saṃsargasthitānāṃ sannipātasthitānāṃ ca, samarthyāllaṅghanādayastiktarasāvasānāḥ pācanāni syuḥ| yathāvasthaṃ-avasthānatikrameṇa| kasyāñcijjvarāvasthāyāṃ laṅghanaṃ-upavāsalakṣaṇaṃ, malānāṃ pācanaṃ syāt| kasyāñcit svedanaṃ syāt| [kasyāñcit ] kālaḥ ṣaḍahākhyaḥ| kasyāñcidyavāgvaḥ-peyāḥ| kasyāñcittiktako rasaḥ-tiktarasāgjrātadravyopayogaḥ| evamavasthāvaśāt laṅghanādayastiktarasāntā malānāmekaikaśaḥ pācanāni syuḥ| athavā krameṇaiva pācanāni syuḥ, yathā-laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ ca kṛtvā ṣaḍahādūrdhvaṃ yavāgvastiktako rasaḥ pācanānyavipakvānāṃ malānāṃ taruṇe jvare syuḥ| tatra "āmāśayasthaḥ" (ślo.1) ityādinā granthena nirdiṣṭā laṅghanayogyāvasthā, "sodardapīnasa" (ślo. 19) ityādinā ca svedanayogyāvasthā, "ityayaṃ ṣaḍaho neyaḥ" (ślo. 38) ityādinā ca nirdiṣṭā kālayogyāvasthā, "yuktaṃ laṅghitaliṅgaistutaṃ" (ślo. 24) ityādinā peyāyogyāvasthā, "udriktapitte" (ślo. 14) ityādinā ca tiktarasopayogayogyāvasthā, iti yathāvasthaṃ draṣṭavyam| kramastu yathā,-vātaśleṣmake sāme jvare prathamaṃ laṅghanaṃ kurvanneva svedanaṃ dvitrādidinalakṣaṇaṃ ca kālaṃ laṅghitalakṣaṇayuktasya yavāgvādipeyādyannabhuktasyānantaraṃ mustāparpaṭakāditiktarasopayogaḥ, iti kramārthaḥ| asyaviśiṣṭaviṣaye+apavādamāha-
ṣaḍahaṃ vā mṛdutvaṃ vā jvaro yāvadavāpnuyāt||25||

sa-kaphārto naro bilvādinā-mahatā, pañcamūlena saha yavasādhitāṃ pibet| taṇḍulā evātra prakṛtitvena yojyāḥ| yavāstukvātha eva| vibaddhaṃ-viṣṭabdhaṃ, varcaḥ-purīṣaṃ, yasya-narasya, sa naraḥ sayavāṃ-yavapradhānāṃ pibet| kimbhūtām ? pippalyāmalakaiḥ kṛtām| tathā, sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭāṃ-samyagājyena saṃskṛtām| tathā, malaḥ-purīṣādiḥ, doṣo-vātādiḥ, teṣāmanulomanīṃ-svamārgapravartinīm|
ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte rakte ca peyāṃ necchanti-----------||36||
ityayaṃ ṣaḍaho neyo balaṃ doṣaṃ ca rakṣatā||38||
tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ kaphe||40||
mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktaṃ śuṇṭhyā duḥsparśayā+api vā||45||

ā raṃ-auṣadhamāha-mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktimiti| tacca pañcadhā,- mustāparpaṭam, śuṇṭhīparpaṭam, durālabhāparpaṭam, pāṭhāditrayam bhūnimbādicatuṣṭayaṃ ca| tacca pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā kṛtvā pibet| pākyaḥ-kvāthaḥ|
jvaraṃ madātyayaṃ chardiṃ mūrcchāṃ dāhaṃ śramaṃ bhramam||58||

tathairaṇḍaṃ jale cāṣṭaguṇe śṛtam|| pakvagomūtrasaṃyuktaṃ biḍasauvarcalānvitam| hṛdbastiśūle sānāhe+apyabhinyāsajvare hitam|| dantīṃ dravantīṃ bṛhatīṃ sairaṇḍaṃ [ bījapūrakam| śyāmāṃ vyāghrīṃ ca niṣkvāthyābhinyāse bahuvarcasi|| siṃhī vyāghryamṛtā drākṣā ajājī sakaṭutrikam| śṛṅgīviḍaṅga ca samaṃ paktvā visrāvya sādhayet|| ghṛtāktaistaṇḍulairbhṛṣṭaiḥ peyāmuṣṇāṃ jvarī pibet| hikkī śvāsī ca kāsī ca tathā+abhinyāsapīḍitaḥ| vibaddhavātaviṇmūtre pānamasya prayojayet|| bṛhatī pauṣkaraṃ bhārgī śaṭhī śṛṅgī durālabhā| paktvā pānaṃ praśaṃsanti śleṣmā tenāsya śāmyati|| trivṛddhiśālātriphalākaṭukāragvadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ| sakṣāro bhedanaḥ kvāthaḥ peyaḥ sarvajvarāpahaḥ|| tiktā+abhayā trivṛttīrṇā trāyantī rājavṛkṣakaḥ| kṣārāḍhyaḥ saindhavopetaḥ kvātho bhedī jvarāpahaḥ|| śirīṣabījaṃ maricaṃ bastamūtreṇa tatsamam| añjanaṃ tadabhinyāse saṃjñābodhanamiṣyate|| mātuluṅgarasaṃ tasya hiṅguśuṇṭhīyutaṃ mukhe| dadyātprabodhanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktopasaṃhitam|| tvagelāpatrasuṣavībṛhatīkaṇṭakārikāḥ| marīcaṃ pippalī bilvaṃ ciribilvaṃ sacitrakam|| karañjabījaṃ mañjiṣṭhā trāyantī viśvabheṣajam| galaprabodhanaṃ śreṣṭhamabhinyāsajvarāpaham|| karañjavahnimañjiṣṭhātrāyantīviśvakūlakam| kūlakaṃ-paṭolam| bṛhatyau suṣavī vyoṣaṃ kvāthaḥ syādgalaśodhanaḥ|| ityabhinyasa uddiṣṭaḥ sarūpaḥ sacikitsitaḥ| cikitsite kṛte+apyevaṃ [yasya saṃjñā na jāyate| lalāṭe pādayorvā+api ] tasya dāhaḥ praśasyate|| (ślo. 490)-jyotiṣmatyāstathā tailaṃ mūlaṃ piṇḍālukasya ca| tandrīvināśanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nasya karmaṇi yojitam|| saindhavaṃ śvetamaricaṃ sarṣapaṃ kuṣṭhameva ca| bastamūtreṇa piṣṭāni nasyaṃ tandrīnivāraṇam|| asurāhnapataṅgasya viṭ cūrṇaṃ madhusaṃyutam| añjanādbodhayenmugdhaṃ tandritaṃ sannipātinam|| jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca rohiṇī maricaṃ vacā| saindhavaṃ bastamūtreṇa tandrīnāśanamuttamam|| ayorajaḥ śvetarodhramañjanaṃ maricaṃ tathā| gopittena samāyuktaṃ tandrīnāśanamuttamam||" iti| iti sannipātajvaraḥ|
kaṣāyaṃ taṃ piban kāle jvarān sarvānapohati||68||
peyā kaphaṃ vardhayati paṅkaṃ pāṃsuṣu vṛṣṭivat||70||
raktādyāḥ śālayo jīrṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikāśca jvare hitāḥ||72||
tāni kvathitaśītaṃ ca vāti madyaṃ ca sātmyataḥ||79||
rūkṣaṃ hi tejo jvarakṛttejasā rūkṣitasya ca||84||
pūrve kaṣāyāḥ saghṛtāḥ sarve yojyā yathāmalam||88||
ghṛtamāśu nihanti sādhitaṃ jvaramagniṃ viṣamaṃ halīmakam||91||
tiktakaṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ ca paittike yacca pālanikayā śṛtaṃ haviḥ||92||
balaṃ hyalaṃ doṣaharaṃ paraṃ tacca balapradam||95||
prāyeṇa tasmānna hitā jīrṇe vātottare jvare||96||
pakve tu śithile doṣe jvare vā viṣamadyaje||99||
āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā||101||
pakvo+api hi vikurvīta doṣaḥ koṣṭhe kṛtāspadaḥ||103||
jvarakṣīṇasya na hitaṃ vamanaṃ na virecanam||105||
kāmaṃ tu payasā tasya niruhairvā harenmalān||2||
caturguṇenāmbhasā vā pippalyā vā śṛtaṃ pibet||111||
niruhastu balaṃ vahniṃ vijvaratvaṃ mudaṃ rucim||116||
doṣe yuktaḥ karotyāśu pakve pakvāśāyaṃ gate||116||
pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pakvāśayagataṃ haret||117||
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ pippplīṃ madhukaṃ vacām||123||
ṛddhiṃ rāsrāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm||123||
piṣṭvā kṣīraṃ jalaṃ sarpistailaṃ caikatra sādhitam||124||
ye ca siddhiṣu vakṣyante bastayo jvaranāśanāḥ||125||
ā raṃ-dāhasyauṣadhānyāha-dāhe sahasradhauteneti| sahasradhautena-sahasrakṛtvo dhautena| yāvati majjati tāvacśītodake ṅṛtaṃ prakṣipya hastena mardayet, tadudakaṃ srāvayet, ityeko vāraḥ, evaṃ sahasram|
śiro gātraṃ ca taireva nātipiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet||133||
taṃ ca śīlayataḥ śīghraṃ sadāho naśyati jvaraḥ||136||
anyaiśca tadvidhairdravyaiḥ śīte tailaṃ jvare pacet||140||
prātaḥ satailaṃ laśunaṃ prāgbhakraṃ vā tathā ṅṛtam||155||

ā raṃ-prayogāntaramāha-surāmiti| surāmanyadvā tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ, śi(khītitirikukkuṭānmāṃsaṃ,]... anyadvā medhyo9dyo) [ṣṇavīryaṃ-a](ṅī)yoṣṇamāṃsaṃ, annena saha jvarotpattidine sevitvā svapyāt| na jīryati cedullikhet-vamet|
sarpiṣo mahatīm mātrāṃ pītvā vā śhardayetpunaḥ||159||
ā raṃ-virecanamāha-nīlinīmiti| sadyaḥsnehanaṃ svedaṃ ca kṛtvā nīlinyādicatuṣṭayaṃ jvarotpattidine pibet|
ā raṃ-dhūpamāha-palaṅkaṣeti| palaṅkaṣā-gugguluḥ| dhūpāntaramāha-viḍvā biḍālajeti| viḍālajā viṭmārjāraviṣṭhā|
ā raṃ-aparājitaṃ dhūpamāha-purādhyāmeti| purogugguluḥ| dhyāmakaṃ-tṛṇam| sarjo-rālā|
ā raṃ-unmādādiṣūktān dhūpādīnatidiśati-dhūpanasyāñjanontrāsā iti| untrāsaḥ-akasmādbhayotpādanam| cittavaikṛtaṃ-unmādo+apasmāraśca, tatra ye uktāste kāryāḥ|
daivāśrayaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jvarān sarvān vyapohati||165||

saṃ-na kevalaṃ dhūpādayo jvaraṃ nāśyanti| daivāśrayaṃ cauṣadhaṃ maṇimaṅgalabalyupahāraprāyaścittajapadānasvastyayanahomādikaṃ sarvān jvarān-āgantūnnijāṃśca, vyapohati| "upasargādasyatyūhyorvā vacanam (rveti vācyam)" iti taṅabhāvaḥ| viśeṣeṇa viṣamān vyapohati| yasmātte-viṣamajvarāḥ, āgantunāṃ-bhūtādīnāṃ, anubandhajjātāḥ|
ā raṃ-daivavyapāśrayamauṣadhamāha-daivāśrayaṃ ceti| daiṅāśrayaṃ-japahomādi| hi-yasmāt, prāyo-bāhulyena, te viṣamāḥ, āgantvanubandhajāḥ-grahāveśādisambhavāḥ|

ā raṃ-athāgantujvaraḥ| tatrābhiṅātajanmauṣadhamāha-kevalānileti| kevalanilajo visarpajo visphoṭajaśca jvarastulyauṣadhatvāduktaḥ| kintvasāvāgantuḥ| kintu nijabhedaḥ kevalaḥ-pittakaphāmairasaṃspṛ(sṛ)ṣṭaḥ|
krodhajo yāti kāmena śāntiṃ krodhena kāmajaḥ||170||
te jvarāḥ kevalāḥ pūrvaṃ vyāpyante+anantaraṃ malaiḥ||171||

ā0 ra0-śāpajābhicārajayorauṣadhamāha-śāpāthavarṇamantrottha iti| ............vaṅgasene tu (jvara. ślo. 541)-"auṣadhīgandha[viṣajau viṣapittaprabādhanaiḥ| jayetkaṣāyairmatimān sarvagandhakṛtairbhiṣak|| ]" iti| ityāgantujvaraḥ| atha dhātujvaraḥ| [ saṅgrahe tu (ci. a. 2)-] "rasasaṃsthe tu sarvasmin kuryādvamanalaṅṅane| sekasaṃśamanāleparaktamokṣānasṛksthite|| tīkṣṇān virekān māṃsasthe medoghnaṃ medasi sthite| asthisthe vātaśamanamabhyaṅgasvedamardanam|| jvare vātārtiśamana viśeṣādbastikarma ca|" iti|
ā raṃ-atha sarvajvarasādhāraṇāni| tatra manoharasevāmāha-jvarakālasmṛtimiti| jvarakālo-jvaravegakālaḥ, tasya smṛtiḥ-asminkāla ādhattā iti smaraṇam|
ā raṃ-sahasā+a+ahāravṛddiṃ niṣedhati-na vijvaro+apīti| sarvānnamatīti sarvānnīnaḥ| niṣedhātikrame doṣamāha-nivṛtto+apīti|
prītikarā manaso viṣayāśca ghnantyapi viṣṇukṛtaṃ jvaramugram||177||

ā raṃ-siddauṣadhādidhāraṇamāha-auṣadhaya iti| saṅgrahe tu (ci.a. 2)-"kṛtyā trivargasaṃyuktā ruḍnidrādivinodinī| śāstraṃ vicitraṃ śṛṇuyānna pretavyādhitāśrayam|| manobhirāmaviṣayaṃ vacanaṃ hlādi dakṣiṇam| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ devān vaidyān viprān haraṃ harim|| pūjayecśīlayeddānadamasatyadayārjavān| dhārayecca śucirmūrdhnā maṇiratnamahauṣadhīḥ|| āryāvalokitaṃ parṇaśabarīmaparājitām| praṇamedāryatārāṃ ca sarvajvaranivṛttaye| japaṃstathā gatoṣṇīṣaṃ sarvavyādhicikitsitam| āgantudoṣasahajaiḥ sarvarogairvimucyate||" iti|| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| jvaraprakaraṇaṃ nāma samastyena nirūpitam|| 1||
śāntaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ kupyanmārgānmārgāntaraṃ ca yat||2||
laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vā+a+adau śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ tathā||4||
adhoge raktapitte tu bṛṃhaṇau madhuro rasaḥ||7||
ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ prāk ca peyā tvadhogate||8||
āśnato balino+aśuddhaṃ na dhāryaṃ taddhi rogakṛt||8||
trivṛtā triphalā śyāmā pippalī śarkarā madhu||10||
sasitaṃ vā jalaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā madhukodakam||12||
mantho jvarokto drākṣādiḥ, pittaghnairvā phalaiḥ kṛtaḥ||14||
śūkaśimbībhavaṃ dhānyaṃ rakte śākaṃ ca śasyate||21||
laghunā śṛtaśītaṃ vā madhvambho vā phalāmbu vā||22||
vṛṣaḥ sadyo jayatyasraṃ, sa hyasya paramauṣadham||26||
sthitaṃ tadguptamākāśe rātriṃ prātaḥ srutaṃ jalam||34||
ye ca pittajvare coktāḥ kaṣāyāstāṃśca yojayet||35||
pītvā kaṣāyān payasā bhuñjīta payasaiva ca||41||
raktapitte hitaṃ tacca kṣatakṣīṇe hitaṃ ca yat||50||
yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita sthāne raktapittacikitsitaṃ nāma dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ||2||
sabiḍaiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ taccūrṇaṃ vā ghṛtaplutam||11||
viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam||12||
dusparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustāṃ bhārṅgī karkaṭakīṃ śaṭhīm||14||
tadvatsakṛṣṇāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ ca sabhārṅgī tadvadeva ca||15||
mastunā sasitāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadhnā vā kaṇareṇukām||16||
kāsī sapīnaso dhūmaṃ snaihikaṃ vidhinā pibet||18||
kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalaṃ patraṃ bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam||24||
pittakāse tu sakaphe vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam||25||
hṛtadoṣo himaṃ svādu snigdhaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ bhajet||28||
ghane kaphe tu śiśiraṃ rūkṣaṃ tiktopasaṃhitam||28||
drākṣāṃ kaṇāṃ pañcamūlaṃ tṛṇākhyaṃ ca pacejjale||36||
sādhitāṃ tena peyāṃ vā suśītāṃ madhunā+anvitām||37||
daśamūlāmbu gharmāmbu madyaṃ madhvambu vā pibet||44||
pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyā dhātrī sitopalā||50||
sakaṇaṃ kvathitaṃ mūtre kaphakāsī jale+api vā||54||
ghṛtaṃ rase viḍaṅgānāṃ vyoṣagarbhaṃ ca sādhitam||58||
ghṛtaṃ trikaṭunā ca siddhamupayujya sañjāyate na kāsaviṣamajvarakṣayagudāṅkurebhyo bhayam||58||
darvīlepini śīte ca pṛthak dvikuḍavaṃ kṣipet||66||
śamanaṃ ca pibeddhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ bahale kaphe||67||
niṣṭhyūtānte guḍayutaṃ koṣṇaṃ dhūmo nihanti saḥ||69||
kāse karma sapitte tu kaphaje tiktasaṃyutam||72||
tvakkṣīrī samitaṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet||75||
madhunā guṭikā ghnanti tā vṛṣyāḥ pittaśoṇitam||82||
jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ śuṇṭhī varī vīrā punarnavā||94||
śṛṅgāṭakaṃ payasyā ca pañcamūlaṃ ca yallaghu||95||

sūtroditena vidhinā sādhu tena tathā vamet||9||

ā raṃ-anyadāha-hṛddāha iti| phalapippalīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣaireyīṃ vā hṛddāhe+adhosrapitte ca pibet| kṣaireyīṃ-kṣīrapeyām| kṣīraṃ ca-tatpippalīśṛtameva| saṅgrahe tu (ka. a.1)-"tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite uraḥkaṇṭhahṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe|" iti|
evameva phalābhāve kalpyaṃ puṣpaṃ śalāṭu vā||19||
payaḥ puṣpe+asya nirvṛtte, phale peyā payaskṛtā||20||

ā raṃ-prayogamāha-paya iti| asya-jīmūtasya, puṣpe nirvṛtte puṣpasiddhaṃ payaḥ prayoktavyam| phale phalasiddhakṣīrapeyā| lomaśe phale tatsiddhakṣīrasantānikā| cyutalomani phale tatsiddhakṣīradadhisaraṃ dadhi vā| haritapāṇḍuni phale tatsiddhakṣīrajamamlaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ vā| haritapāṇḍubhirvāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ āsunuyāt-avasthāntaraṃ nayet| tato mṛditagālitaṃ kaphajeṣvarocakādiṣu pibet|
dwe vā trīṇyapi vā+a+apothya kwāthe tiktottamasya vā||24||
vimṛdya pūtaṃ taṃ kwāthaṃ pittaśleṣmajwarī pibet||25||
hṛtamadhye phale jīrṇe sthitaṃ kṣīraṃ yadā dadhi||29||
syāttadā kaphaje kāse śwāse vamyaṃ ca pāyayet||29||

ikṣvākuphalasya jaraṭhāvasthasya prayogamāha---- sa0-hṛtamadhye jīrṇe-supakve, tasmin ikṣvāko phale hṛtamadhyabhāgatvācchūnyamadhye kṣīraṃ sthitaṃ sat yadā dadhi jātaṃ syāttadā kaphakāsādiṣu vamanārthaṃ pāyayet|
gulme jvare prasakte ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet||33||
naraḥ sādhu vamatyevaṃ na ca daurbalyamaśnute||33||
sa-(tumbyāḥ phalarasaiḥ puṣparasaiścāvacūrṇitaṃ śuṣkaiḥ-śoṣitaiḥ,tumbiphalarasaistumbipuṣpacūrṇamiśritairavacūrṇitaṃ mālyāmāghrāya sukhaṃ vamet| gandhasampat-gandhasampattimat|)

ā0 r0 -anyadāha-tumbyā iti| tumbīphalarasaiḥ tumbīpuṣpacūrṇamiśritaiḥ śoṣitairavacūrṇitaṃ mālyamāghrāya sukhaṃ vamet| gandhasampat-gandhasampattimat| saṅgrahe tu (ka. a. 1)-"ikṣvakuphalasvarasaṃ vā triguṇakṣīrasādhitamuraḥsthite kaphe pīnase svarasāde ca pibet| bilvamūlaprasthakvāthena vā tumbībījāni kvāthayet| tatastamiṃstribhāgaghṛte ghṛtasamāni ca piṣṭvā tumbībījāni tadardhāṃśikāni ca pratyekaṃ jīmūtamahājālinīvatsakakṛtavedhanāni kvāthatulyameva ca trikaṭukamāvapet| tataḥ punaradhiśritya lehaṃ sādhayet| tamavalihya pramathyāmanu pibet| ayameva ca kalpaḥ kāśmaryādiṣu caturṣu mahāpañcamūlāṅgeṣu pṛthak pṛthagukto veditabyaḥ vātakaphagulmaprasaktajvareṣu||" iti|
dhāmārgavo gadeṣviṣṭaḥ sthireṣu ca mahatsu ca||36||
bimyāḥ punarnavāyā vā kāsamardasya vā rase||39||
ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā mānase mṛditaṃ pibet||40||
koṣātakyā samaṃ siddhaṃ tadrasaṃ lavaṇaṃ pibet||42||
jvare visarpe hṛdroge khuḍe kuṣṭhe ca pūjitam||44||
ā raṃ-vamanayogānupasaṃharati-vamanauṣadheti| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| vāntyauṣadhaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam||1||
dvidhā khyātaṃ ca tanmūlaṃ śyāmaṃ śyāmā+aruṇaṃ trivṛt||3||
sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca taddhitam||4||
krūre koṣṭhe bahau doṣe kleśakṣamiṇi cāture||5||
sarvaiḥ samā samasitā kṣaudreṇa guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ||22||
bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave||31||
sauvīrakeṇa vā yuktam kalkena traivṛtena vā||36||
dantīkaṣāye tanmajjño guḍaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca nikṣipet||37||
tamariṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ māsaṃ pāyayet pakṣameva vā||37||
viśoṣya cūrṇayitvā ca dvau bhāgau gālayettataḥ||38||
kaṣāye daśamūlasya taṃ bhāgaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ||39||
śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet||40||
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam||41||
dvivarṣāṃ vā trivarṣāṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ||45||
saptāhaṃ snukpayaḥ pītān rasenājyena vā pibet||48||
tatra pūrvoditā vyāpatsiddhiśca, na tathā+api cet||4||
vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hidhmāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ tṛṣam||6||
sodāvartasya cotkleśya doṣān mārgān nirudhya taiḥ||11||
kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham||17||
na gacchedvibhramaṃ tatra vāmayedāśu taṃ bhiṣak||18||
yojyo+ati vamane reko vireke vamanaṃ mṛdu||25||
prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syātpitte śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite||34||
bastiḥ paraṃ sarvagadapramāthī svasthe hito jīvanabṛṃhaṇaśca||3||
bastau ca yasmin paṭhito na kalkaḥ sarvatra dadyādamumeva tatra||3||
ā raṃ- bastikalpo dvividhaḥ,-nirūhakalpo+anuvāsanakalpaṣca| tatrādau nirūhakalpaḥ| tatrāpi vātaharaḥ| balādinirūhamāha-balāmiti ṣiḍaśa pṛthak palonmitāni| apsu-sarvebhyaḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇāsu|
prastho rasācchāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamaḥ sa yāvat||5||
kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya||18||
vakṣye mṛdūn snehakṛto nirūhān sukhocitānāṃ prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak tu||19||
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak||20||
suradāru ca rāsnā ca bastirdoṣaharaḥ śivaḥ||33||
pṛthak daśapalaṃ kṣīre pañcamūlaṃ ca sādhayet||49||
vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca||56||
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām||59||
saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā||62||
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī||63||
bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ samaiḥ||64||
medasvino viṣodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭhamehārtāḥ||72||
yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāna bastikalpo nāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ||4||
oṣṇyāttaikṣṇyātsaratvācca bastiṃ so+asyānulomayet gomūtreṇa trivṛtpathyākalkaṃ vā+adhonulomanam||17||
śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ||21||
alpe doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥpunaḥ||22||
gudaṃ dahan likhan kṣiṇvan karotyasya parisravam||24||
sa vidagdhaṃ sravatyasraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ||24||
śīto+alpo vā+adhike vāte pitte+atyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ||29||
ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhādūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya etyapi||41||
anucchvāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā||45||
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā||47||
yathā+aṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā||51||
dhanve sādhāraṇe deśe same sanmṛttike śucau||1||
tapasā tejasā vā+api praśāmyadhvaṃ śivāya vai||1||
gṛhṇīyādauṣadhaṃ susthaṃ sthitaṃ kāle ca kalpayet||5||
payo bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tacca nīrujām||7||
rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaśceti prakalpanā||8||
mātrāyā na vyavasthā+asti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ||12||
ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvacca kalpanā||12||
madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ svarasasya catuṣpalam||13||
lehasya tantumattā+apsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca||19||
kiñcitsīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartya(rti)māne ca paścimaḥ||20||
mṛdurnasye, kharo+abhyaṅge, pāne bastau ca cikkaṇaḥ||21||
aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syādaprasiddhau tadeva tu||25||
] dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṃkṣaṇaśca, tau||25||
palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭirāmraṃ caturthikā||27||
dve pale prasṛtastau dvāvañjalistau tu mānikā||28||
āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso, droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo+armaṇam||28||
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sañjīva śaradāṃ śatam||3||
tṛtīye+ahni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate||12||
dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ, tataḥ||13||
stanyābhāve payaśchāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet||20||
trāsayennāvidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ||41||
hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā||48||

asmādanantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogāstaccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- sa0-bālastriprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano+annavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ| śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati|

asmādanantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogāstaccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- sa0-bālastriprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano+annavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ|
sa yaṃ spṛśedbhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ||6||
tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet||9||
bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tairvā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam||13||
kṣīrālasakamityāhuratyayaṃ cātidāruṇam tatrāśu dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopapādayet||23||
dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcinna dūyate||28||
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāśca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat||30||
pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā||58||
sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto+anu pītastaṃ taṃ jayedgadam||77||
asmādanantaraṃ bālagrahapratiṣedha ucyate, grahāṇāmapi roga hetutvāt| sa0-bālānāṃ grahā bālagrahāḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho yasmin sa bālagrahapratiṣedhaḥ, tam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||3||
skandārtastena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam||9||
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ, madhye vinamanaṃ, jvaraḥ||14||
niśyahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude+api vā||19||
bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam||28||
udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt||30||
jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet||31||
sa0-hiṃsā ca ratiścārcanā ca, tāsāmākāṅkṣā-abhilāṣaḥ, sā grahāṇāṃ grahaṇe kāraṇaṃ-hetuḥ|
tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ||33||
kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdgāti na jugupsate||34||
hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hantyātmānaṃ tathā param||35||
raktaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet||37||
atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam||41||
ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca||58||
utkvāthya toyaṃ tadrātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam||60||
dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vā+a+alihānaṃ daśanacchadau||29||
yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta vijñānīyo nāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ||4||

bhūtagrahavijñānādanantaraṃ bhūtasya pratiṣedhaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, ucyate| nanu, nidānacikitsitapadābhyāṃ prasiddhatarābhyāṃ pūrvavatkimitīdaṃ tantrakṛtā nopanibaddham ? iti keciccodyamacūcudan| tān sañcakṣmahe| śāstrakārasyāsyedṛśī pratijñā,-sūtraśārīranidāna cikitsitakalpottarākhyaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānaistantramidamabhidheyamiti| tadevaṃ yadyuttare sthāne+api kiñcinnidānacikitsitapadābhyāmabhidhīyate, tataḥ ṣaṭsthānakamidaṃ tantramiti pratijñāṃ vyāhanyāt| tasmādayaṃ viracanāprakāraviśeṣaḥ kṛtaḥ|
abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyameṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane||6||
siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam||12||
bījaṃ karañjāt, kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt||15||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca||16||
viṣātārkṣyaśailaiḥ sacavyāmayaiḥ kalkitairghṛtamanavamaśeṣamūtrāṃśasiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatastad grahaghnaṃ param||19||
gnibilvaiḥ samaiḥkalkitairmūtravargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidhivinihitamāśu sarvaiḥ kramairyojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃstanmahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam||20||
grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ||21||
dadhi chatraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ baliriṣyate||29||
śvetapatraṃ ca rodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ||33||
haritakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā||36||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam||38||
ebhireva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe||43||
piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi||44||
mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayetsadā||51||
bhūtapratiṣedhādanantaramunmādāpasmārapratiṣedha ucyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt| tatrāpyapasmārādunmādasya pūrvamupanyāso bahuvaktavyatvādityāha- sa0-unmādasya pratiṣedha-cikitsitaṃ, bhaṇiṣyāmaḥ|
dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hatva mārgān manovahān||5||
unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate||13||
unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||14||
yuñjyāttāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ||22||
dvau prasthau svarasād brāhayā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam||23||
pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare||29||
jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā||34||
brāhmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām||38||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām||39||

sa-"kalkādyairavapīḍastu" (hṛ.sū.a. 20/7) iti kathito+avapīḍaḥ| te+avapīḍāḥ sarṣapatailayutā hitāḥ| abhyaṅgaśca sarṣapatailena| tathā+asya tadrajaḥ-sarṣapacūrṇaṃ, ghrāṇe dhmāpayet| tathā sūtrasthānoktastīkṣṇo dhūmo (a. 21/17) hiṅgunā saha hitaḥ|
tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ||45||
vidhyecchirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā||46||
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||52||
catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca||58||
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca||2||
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||3||
pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam||8||
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan||9||
apasmarati pittena muhuḥ saṃjñā ca vindati||12||
prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcaganyamidaṃ mahat||23||
kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvane paramaṃ hitam||29||
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca śasyate||31||
bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayedbhiṣak||32||

apasmārādanantaraṃ śālākyamupakramyate| yathaiva hṛdayākhyamahāmarmāśritairapasmāro janyate tathaiva murdhākhyamahāmarmāśritairūrdhvajatrūtthā rogā janyante| teṣāmapi ca madhye cakṣūrogāṇāṃ sa0-vartmani rogā vartmarogāḥ,-kṛcchronmīlādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānaṃ-bodhaḥ, sa vidyate yasminniti chaḥ, tasya pūrvavalluk|
vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvamakṣi vā||2||
vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat||4||
vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vātahataṃ hi tat||6||
karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitam||8||
pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam||9||
pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapabhā ghanāḥ kaphāt||9||
raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate||13||
madhye vā vartmano+ante vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā||14||
ādyo+atra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato+arśaśca varjayet||25||
na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatastataḥ||4||
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam||13||
lekhane bhedane cāyaṃ kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani||16||
likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam||17||
kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnamannaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ||30||
utsṛjya dvau bhruvo+adhastādbhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ||35||
badhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam||37||
vartmarogapratiṣedhādanantaraṃ sthānānupūrvyā sandhisitāsitarogavijñānamārabhyate- saṃ-sandhī ca sitāsitau ca sandhisitāsitāḥ, teṣu rogāḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet||2||
raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet||4||
tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī||5||
aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpā taḥ sa śoṇitāt||14||
yasya vā liṅganāśo+antaḥ śyāvaṃ yadvā salohitam||30||
purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam||31||
tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitāsitarogavijñhānīyo nāma daśamo+adhyāyaḥ||10||
sa0-pratiṣidhyate nirākriyate cikitsyata iti pratiṣedhaḥ,-cikitsā| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca||1||
kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca||6||
madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha||12||
armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat||13||
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ||17||
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā||27||
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhirlikhet||48||
ajakāṃ pāṛśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam||55||
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca||56||
saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire||56||
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā||57||

asmādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogavijñānamāha| tatrāpi pūrvaṃ timiraṃ lilakṣayiṣurāha- sa0-[ male- ] doṣe vātādyanyatame, sirānusāriṇi tathā prathamaṃ-bāhyaṃ, paṭalaṃ śrite satyavyaktaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati| vyaktamapi kadācinnimittamantareṇa paśyati| eṣa timirākhyo roga iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
bhūtaṃ tu yatnādāsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate||2||
yathā varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirhīyeta ca kramāt||7||
kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛgeva ca paśyati||14||
dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hṛsva hrasvadarśinī||15||
kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati||16||
sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syālliṅganāśe tu lakṣyate||18||
raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati||20||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭistadṛk ca paśyati||21||
dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ||23||
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi||24||
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado+aparaḥ||25||
rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā||28||
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ||30||
ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaśca yāpyāḥ, śeṣāṃstu sādhayet||33||

sa0-nanu, dṛṣṭirogavijñānādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogapratiṣedho jñāpyaḥ| upapannamāha bhavān| kiṃ tu dṛṣṭitogacikitsitasya bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo vaktuṃ yuktaḥ| tatrāpi kramaprāptastimirapratiṣedha iti timirapratiṣedhārambha eva yuktaḥ| kācādīnāṃ tvalpavaktavyatvādatraivābhidhānam| tato bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo liṅganāśasya| iti sarvaṃ yuktam|
gomūtre chagaṇarase+amlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca||33||
yattutthaṃ jvalitamanekaśo niṣiktaṃ tatkuryādgaruḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ||33||
yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yatsīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||34||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā+anañjanā vā||35||
taimiryārmasrāpapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti||35||
nirdagdhaṃ samadhṛtamañjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo+ayaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram||37||
ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ srotoñjanaṃ tāmramayaḥ saśaṅkham||45||
vasā+añjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate||56||
sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭairlepo mukhasya ca||76||
sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirobastau ca śasyate||77||
tatsrutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacetkṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet||78||
tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭhamañjanam||88||
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet||89||
bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam||90||
kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam||93||
yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||96||
santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam||97||
vyartho loko+ayaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne+api vitte||98||
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā||99||
tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara sthāne timirapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ||13||

liṅganāśastimirapratiṣedhātpṛthagucyate, bahuvaktavyatvāt| sa0-sujātaṃ-suṣṭhu ghanībhūtaṃ, liṅganāśaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ kaphodbhavaṃ vidhyet| śeṣāstu liṅganāśā asādhyā iti na tān vidhyet| tathā+a+avartakyādibhirvakṣyamāṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirupadravairvivarjitam|
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayetpunaḥ||3||
chatrābhā naikavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā||7||
svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite||11||
sthire doṣe cale vā+ati svedayedakṣi bāhyataḥ||16||
manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryādvedhe rūḍhe+añjanaṃ mṛdu||29||
ājena tāmramamunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam||31||
piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitamanātapaśuṣkamakṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca dṛṣṭeḥ||32||
yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma catu rdaśo+adhyāyaḥ||14||
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītamacchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ||2||
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā||5||
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ||8||
raktotpanno hanti tadvattrirātrāt mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva||24||
sa0-syandeṣu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāṃ tīkṣṇameva gaṇḍūṣādikamupavāsaṃ ca syandavantaṃ kārayet, vātotthaṃ kopaṃ muktvā|
saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ||3||
taccūrṇaṃ sakṛdavacūrṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam||6||
ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham||8||
taruṇamurubūkapatraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddhamāje kṣīre||10||
jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet||25||
ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param||27||
tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam||34.5||
tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ||34.5||
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ patrairdhūpitaṃ tadyavaiśca||35.5||
netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām||35.5||
stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayecca taiḥ||40||
alaṃ ca sauvīrakamañjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam||56||
dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā||57||
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām||63||
saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam||63||
dve pādamadhye pṛthusanniveśe śire gate te bahudhā ca netre tā mrakṣaṇodvartanalepanādīn pādaprayuktānnayane nayanti||66||
cirācca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkāmalpaśaḥ sravet||3||

nayanāmayādanantaraṃ dūragrahaṇasādharmyeṇa karṇarogānāha| yathā hi cakṣurdūradeśasthamapi paśyati tathā śrotraṃ dūrasthamapi śṛṇotītyāha- sa0-pratiśyāyetyādibhiḥ śabdasya ca mithyābhiyogena pavanaḥ kupito+aparairapi sarvanidānaiḥ kupitaḥ śrotrasirāḥ prāpya srotasi-karṇavivare, śūlaṃ vegavat kuryāt| tathā+ardhāvabhedakaṃ śirorogaṃ stambhaṃ karṇasyaiva, tathā śītasyānabhinandanaṃ cireṇa ca pākaṃ kuryāt| pakvaṃ tu śrotramalpaśo lasīkāṃ sravet| akasmācca śūnyaṃ syāt| sañcāravicāravacca-sthagitāsthagitaṃ ca yathā, syāt|
vātena ṣoṣitaḥ ṣleṣmā ṣroto limpettato bhavet||11||
kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tvapi||12||
teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate||15||
eko nīruganeko vā garbhe māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ||16||
savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ, sa upekṣitaḥ||17||
saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm||18||
kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā||19||
śvayath uḥ sannipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkhavardhanaḥ||24||
iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo+adhyāyaḥ||17||
vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ, karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet||1||

asmādanantarametaccikitsocyata ityāha- sa0-vātodbhave karṇaśūle māṃsarasena bhojito vātaghnadravyasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ niśi pibet| karṇaṃ ca svinnaṃ santaṃ pṛthagaśvatthādijānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tailasaindhavadigdhānāṃ puṭapākataḥ svinnānāṃ rasaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ pūrayet| tathaiva mūlakasya rasena syonākasya ca rasena pūrayet|
srotaḥ pramujya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ||18||
karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe||26||
atha suptāviva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ harettataḥ||30||
svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīmudvartayettilaiḥ||38||
surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam||46||
chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandhamālocya yaugikam||51||
niveśya sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam||52||
ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam||58||
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā||61||
kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ||2||
sa0-avaśyāyādibhirvātolbaṇā doṣāḥ kruddhā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ-ghanatvaṃ prāptāḥ, pratiśyāyaṃ janayanti| kimbhūtam ? vivardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam|
ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakwaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam||21||

kapho nāsāyāṃ pravṛddho ruddhvā srotāṃsyapīnasaṃ ghurghuraśvāsayutaṃ pīnasādhikarujaṃ kuryāt| tena-apīnasena, asya rogiṇo meṣasyevānavarataṃ praklinnā nāsikā picchilādiyuktaṃ kaphaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ sravati|
śleṣmā ca pūtirnirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam||23||
kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat||25||
kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet||4||

sa0-pīnaseṣvakhileṣvapi nivātaveśmasthitaḥ san snehanasvedanavamanadhūmān gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaṃ ca sevet| tathā vastraṃ gurūṣṇasvabhāvaṃ kauśeyāvikādibhirmūrdhnaḥ pariveṣṭanaṃ sughanaṃ bhajet| tathā bhojanaṃ laghvādiguṇaṃ bhajet| dāḍimaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ-dāḍimasāram| dadhidāḍimasādhitamiti kecit paṭhanti| bālamūlakottho yūṣaḥ kulatthajaśca yūṣaḥ pūjitaḥ| daśamūlāmbu koṣṇaṃ prasannāṃ vā jīrṇāṃ-purāṇāṃ, pibet| sa0-corakādīn jighret|
tyajetsnānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam||9||
kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet||12||
sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pītvā vamet, piṣṭaistu nāvanam||13||
kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet||17||
kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam||18||
pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau||20||
tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ityukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ||3||
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau||10||
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaśca saḥ||12||
jāyamāne+atirug dante, jāte tatra tu śāmyati||15||
calā mandarujo dantā pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate||23||
tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ||31||

padārthacandrikā-kaphādduṣṭāt tāludeśe yaḥ śvayathuḥ kacchapākāraściravṛddhiraruk ca, sa kacchapa ityucyate| pa0 ca0-śleṣmamedobhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ kolābhaḥ-kolasadṛśo, nīrujaḥ sthiraśca yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa puppuṭa ityucyate|
pa0 ca0-pittena duṣṭena yastālunaḥ pākaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ, sa pākākhyaḥ-pākasaṃjñaḥ|
pa0 ca0-vātapittajvarāyāsaiḥ pratibaddho yaḥ śoṣastāluśoṣaḥ, sa tadāhvayaḥ-tāluśoṣa ityucyate| ityaṣṭau tālurogāḥ|

pa0 ca0-kaṇṭhe-kaṇṭhapradeśe, ye māṃsāṅkurā jihvāprabandhajāḥ-jihvāmūlotthāḥ, dāruṇāḥ-duḥsahāḥ, kaṇṭhamārgānurodhinaḥ śīghracayāḥ-satvarodbhūtāḥ, bhavanti| sā śīghrakāriṇī-āśuvyāpādanaśīlā, rohiṇītyucyate|
pa0 ca0-sā-rohiṇī, vātātsamutpannā kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaṃ karoti| hanvoḥ śrotrayośca rujaṃ karoti|
pa0 ca0-pittād rohiṇī jvarādibhiranvitā syāt| kṣiprajā-śīghrotthānā| śīghrapākā atirāgiṇī-bhṛśalohitā| sparśanāsahā-sparśaṃ na sahate| paṃ caṃ-kaphena duṣṭena rohiṇī picchilā pāṇḍurā ca bhavet|
pa0 ca0-asṛjā-raktena duṣṭena, rohiṇī sphoṭakairācitā samantāt vyāptā syāt| taptāṅgāranibhā-varṇataḥ sparśato vā, karṇayo rujāṃ karoti| pittajākṛtiḥ-pittottharohiṇīlakṣaṇasamanvitā bhavet|

pa0 ca0-nicayāt-sannipātāt, rohiṇī gambhīrapākāgūḍhapākā, syāt| sarvaliṅgaiḥ-vātādīnāṃ sambandhibhiḥ, samanvitā-yuktā, syāt| pa0 ca0-doṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, kapholbaṇaiḥ-kaphapradhānaiḥ, kaṇṭhe kolavad grathitonnataḥ śūkakaṇṭakavat mārgarodhano yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa kaṇṭhaśālūka ityucyate|

pa0 ca0-kaṇṭhe vṛttonnato galapārśvago yaḥ śopho bhavati, dāhajvaraṃ karoti, sa nāmnā vṛnda ityucyate| pa0 ca0-kaṇṭhapradeśe śophaḥ kārpāsyāḥ phalasannibhaḥ-tadākāraḥ, picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhinaśca| sa nāmnā tuṇḍikeriketyucyate|

pa0 ca0-kaṇṭhe śvayathurbāhyāntarghoro-dustaro, galamārgārgalopamaḥ-sa iva, jāyate| mūrddhagurutādīṃśca pradadāti| sa galaugha ityucyate| pa0 ca0-gale yaḥ śopho nātiruk āyatonnataḥ syāt, sa vyādhirvalayamityucyate| tadvadeva-valayākṛtitvāt|

pa0 ca0-doṣaiḥ vātādibhirduṣṭaiḥ, gale māṃsakīla eko+aneko vā+alparug jāto mūle pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇaḥ, kṛcchrāt-duḥkhena, ucchvāsābhyavahṛtirya(tī ya)sya saḥ| tathāvidho vyādhirgilāyuka ityucyate| pa0 ca0-bhūribhiḥ-prabhūtaiḥ, māṃsāṅkurairāvṛtā-parivṛtā, tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharugyutā vṛttā yā vartiḥ sā śataghnī| nicayātsañcayaṃ prāptā śataghnīvaccātirukkarī| sa vyādhirnāmnā śataghnītyucyate| śataghnī-śastraviśeṣaḥ|

pa0 ca0-vyāptaḥ sarvagalaḥ-kaṇṭho, yeneti| evaṃvidho yaḥ śvayathuḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ pūti-durgandhi, pūyasadṛśaṃ sravati malaṃ,sa galavidradhirityucyate| pa0 ca0-jihvāvasāne-paryante, kaṇṭhādau śvayathumapākaṃ sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ malāḥ-doṣāḥ, janayanti| tadgalārbudaṃ smṛtam|
pa0 ca0-duṣṭaiḥ pavanaśleṣmamedobhirgalasya bahirgalagaṇḍo nāma vyādhirbhavet| sa ca kālena vivardhamāno
sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt||55||
pa0 ca0-kaphātprakupitāt gale galagaṇḍo jātaḥ sthiraḥ samānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍumān śītasparśo guruśca bhavet| vṛddhaḥ san tālugale lepaṃ kuryāt| tathā madhurāsyatāṃ-madhuravaktratvaṃ ca, kuryāt|
dehaṃ vṛddhaśca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare+alpatām||56||

pa0 ca0-medasaḥ pravṛddhādutpanno galagaṇḍaḥ kaphavallakṣaṇairbhavet| sa ca dehaṃ-śarīraṃ, hānivṛddhyoranuvidhīyate-anukaroti| tena dehasya vṛddhau so+api vṛddho bhavet, dehasya kṣayāt kṣīṇaḥ syāt| vṛddhaḥ sa gale śabdaṃ kurute svare cālpatām|
tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahā+anilāt||57||

pa0 ca0-śleṣmaṇā duṣṭena yadā+anilasya-vāyoḥ, gatiḥ ruddhā bhavet| tathā sa ca yena vyādhinā puruṣaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraśca syāt| te(ye)na ca tāmyan-tamogacchan tamaḥpraviśan, prakarṣeṇa saktaṃ śvāsaṃ muñcati| sa vyādhiranilāt-vātāt, svarahāsvaraghnanāmnā, bhavet| iti galarogā aṣṭādaśa|
vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ||59||

pa0 ca0-anilo-vāyuḥ, sarvasaraḥ-sarvataḥ prasaran san, sarvato vadanasyāntarvraṇān sañcāriṇo+aruṇān rūkṣāṃśca karoti| tathauṣṭhau tāmrau-tāmravarṇau, calatvacau| jihvā ca śītāsahā śītasparśākṣamā, gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭakairācitā syāt| sa ca mukhaṃ-vaktraṃ, kṛcchreṇa vivṛṇoti| sa mukhasya pāka ityucyate|
pa0 ca0-arśogulmakaphādibhirvāyuradhaḥ pratihato vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvannūrdhvaṃ yāti| sa ūrdhvaguda iti saṃjñitaḥ|

pa0 ca0-pittaje-pittodbhave, mukhasya pāke dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| tathā tiktavaktratā-tiktāsyatvaṃ, bhavet| vraṇāśca kṣāreṇokṣitaṃ yat kṣataṃ-vraṇaḥ, tena samānāḥ-tatsamarujāḥ, bhavanti| paṃ caṃ-raktaje pāke mukhasyāntaḥ pittajapākavallakṣaṇāni bhavanti|
kuryāttad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate||63||

pa0 ca0-kaphaje pāke madhurāsyatvaṃ-madhuramukhatvaṃ, syāt| tathā kaṇḍūmatpicchilāśca vraṇā bhavanti| pa0 ca0-kapho vṛddho+antaḥkapolamāśrityārbudaṃ śyāvaṃ pāṇḍu ca kuryāt| taccārbudaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca punarvivardhate|

pa0 ca0-malaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, sarvaiḥ-tribhiḥ, sāsraiḥ-saraktaiḥ, mukhasya pāko bhavet| sa ca sarvākṛtiḥ-sarvalakṣaṇaḥ, syāt| pa0 ca0-dantakāṣṭhavidviṣaḥ puṃsastaireva doṣaiḥ pūtyāsyatāpūtivaktratvaṃ, syāt| [iti sarvavaktragā aṣṭau|]
oṣṭe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale||64||
ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ||65||
pa0 ca0-oṣṭhāmayā ekādaśoktāḥ| gaṇḍe ekaḥ| dvijedante, daśa| dantamūle trayodaśa| jihvāyāṃ ṣaṭ| tālunyaṣṭau| gale+aṣṭadaśa| vaktre+aṣṭavāmayāḥ| evaṃ sarvatra pañcasaptatirāmayā ākhyātāḥ-uktāḥ|

pa0 ca0-oṣṭhādyāmayeṣu madhye+anupakramāḥ-asādhyāḥ| karālo nāma dantarogaḥ| mahāsuṣiro dantarogaḥ| svaraghno galarogaḥ| ūrdhvagudo vaktrarogaḥ| śataghnīvalayau kaṇṭharogau| alaso+adhijihvārogaḥ| nicayāt-sannipātāt, nāḍī dantamūlajā| oṣṭhakopaḥ sannipātajo+asādhyaḥ| raktātsannipātāt [ca] jātā rohiṇī| dantabhedo daśane-dante, sphuṭite+asādhyaḥ| pakvopajihvikā+asādhyā| galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ(śī)kṛcchrocchvāso+ativatsaro+asādhyaḥ| pa0 ca0-dantaharṣo dantabhedaśca dvāvetau yāpyau| pa0 ca0-śeṣān rogān śastrauṣadhairjayet| yathāyogairvakṣyamāṇairiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mukharoga- vijñānīyo nāmaikaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 21||
pa0 ca0-khāṇḍauṣṭhasya-chinnauṣṭhasya snigdhasvinnasya, oṣṭhaprāntau vilikhya suṣliṣṭau kṣaumasūtreṇa syūtvā sadyovraṇavadupacāraṃ kuryāt,-śatadhautaghṛtābhyaktāṃ vraṇasyopari kavalikāṃ dadyāt|
pa0 ca0-madhuyaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkitaistailamabhyañjanaṃ pacet| pa0 ca0-vātaharamadhurauṣadhasādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ prayojyam|

pa0 ca0-sarjarasasikthakagugguludevadārubhiḥ siddhena mahāsnehena-sarpirmajjavasātailākhyenāktaḥ, picurvātauṣṭhe-vātaja oṣṭhakope, hitaḥ| pa0 ca0-tenaiva-mahāsnehena, madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayuktena vātauṣṭhe vā pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|
khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam||5||
pa0 ca0- oṣṭhaṃ-vātauṣṭhaṃ, dugdhasiddhaireraṇḍapallavairnāḍyā svedayet| paṃ caṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhoktaṃ, nasyaṃ prayojyam| tathā tasya mūrdhni tarpaṇaṃ-śirobhyaṅgaḥ, kāryaḥ|
pa0 ca0-pittajamabhighātajamo(jaṃ cau)ṣṭhakopaṃ jalaukobhirupācaret-cikitsettābhī raktaṃ srāvayet| pa0 ca0-pittotthe+abhighātaje cauṣṭhakope rodhrādibhiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|

pa0 ca0-guḍūcyādibhiḥ kalkitairghṛtaṃ siddhamabhyañjane hitam| pa0 ca0-atra-[e]tayoḥ pittābhighātajayoḥ, pittavidradhivat kriyā-cikitsā, kāryā| paṃ caṃ-śoṇitaje rakto(navo)tthe idameva-pittoktaṃ, karmakāryam|
dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā||13||
anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā||17||
guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet||20||
rajo rujaṃ jayatyāśu vastrasthaṃ daśane dhṛtam||21||
tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ||24||
ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ||32||
kṣāraṃ yuñjyāttato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam||39||
kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā||41||
nave jihvālase+apyevaṃ, taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet||44||
medobhave sirāṃ vidhyetkaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet||72||
kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ||82||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān||83||
hatvā+a+asye sarvagadān janayati gārdhīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm||86||
kārayedguṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadvadāpahāḥ||94||
attāraṃ naramaṇavo+api vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpamiva na spṛśantyanarthāḥ||102||
pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaścāsyagadānaśeṣān||104||
prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma||109||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā||4||
ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate||5||
kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ||12||
sūryāvartaḥ sa ityuktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ||20||
śirasyeva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava||20||
khalaterapi janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt||26||
dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate||28||
tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet||2||
tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ||5||
varge+atra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram||6||
ityaśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ||9||
kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ||15||
khalatau palite valyāṃ harillomni ca śodhitam||33||
nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ||38||
māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sārivā nīlamutpalam||41||
sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam||45||
jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet||48||
sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ||59||
vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti yeṣāṃ ca syurvraṇe vraṇāḥ||17||
yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaścāśu praśāmyati||24||
śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine vivarṇe vedanānvite||25||
hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ||27||
abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||32||
na mukhe cainamālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate||39||
bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca||41||
chinnāśca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktairye ca śodhanaiḥ||51||
pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syādāśu ropaṇaḥ||55||
dve pañcamūle vargaśca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ||64||
ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā||66||
cūrṇo vartiśca saṃyojyā vraṇe sapta yathāyatham||66||
sarpiḥ sādhyamanena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhdyanti rohanti ca||67||
viracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇapratiṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||25||
raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet||3||
avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ, vicchinnaṃ syāttato+api ca||3||
ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet||14||
asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netramadīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat||16||
tato+asya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ||17||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram||21||
pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā||24||
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ||25||
chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ||27||
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati||41||
dṛḍhaṃ badhvā ca sūtreṇa varddhayetkuśalo bhiṣak||51||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe+anne ghṛtaṃ pibet||53||
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ||55||
samāsāditi bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ, bahudhā tu tat||3||
prajyāṇudāri yattvasthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat||4||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat||7||
jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||7||
śithilena hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate||16||
prātaḥ prātaḥ pibedbhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam||21||
yantraṇārtha tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ||28||
jaṅghorvoḥ pāṛśvayordvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ||28||
bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak||32||
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam||35||
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍumatī kaphāt||9||
pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam||22||
bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet||25||
pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ||31||
abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitametadeṣām||34||
guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthaksyāt||40||
bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni||43||
sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ pariharedadhikaṃ vā||44||
pittātsadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā, pacyate drutam||4||
śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān, pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sravedghanam||5||
vāyunā kurute granthi bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam||8||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca||11||
niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ||11||

saṃ-padāteḥ sahasaiva jalāvagāhād vyāyāmādvā pratāntasyaglānasya, pavanaḥ kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ sirājālaṃ sampīḍya tathā saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāsaṃjñaḥ| niḥṣphuramiti "sphuratisphulatyoḥ" ityādinā ṣatvam|
tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat||15||
sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca||16||
ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe+anūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam||22||

śām-pakvaśophasyābhedanādapathyasevinaśca puṃso vraṇe pūyo māṃsādīnanupraviśya dūraṃ vrajati| sā dūragamanāt gatirityucyate| nāḍīva saṃsruternāḍītyucyate| anyeṣāṃ tu tantrakṛtāṃ mata ekā nāḍyanṛjuḥ-vakrā, nāḍītyucyate| saiva nāḍyanekagatirgatirityucyata iti |
antaḥsthitaṃ śalyamanāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sā+asya||31||
phenānuviddhaṃ tanumalpamuṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam||31||
saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ||2||
eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ, pittāsraje punaḥ||3||
jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ, kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ||3||
sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ, tathā||7||
arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam||8||
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit||11||
tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca pūjitam||28||
aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhirvāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ||29||
sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ||30||
pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendrabastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve||31||
yā vartyo yāni tailāni tannāḍīṣvapi śasyate||37||
ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya patraṃ vanitāpayaśca||38||
srugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hantyacireṇa nāḍīm||38||
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ||3||
medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ||5||
te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmamiva kaṇṭakaiḥ||6||
durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ||18||
granthiḥ kīlavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat||21||
kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam||27||
paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt||29||
aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ||4||
vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca||6||
pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāśca śodhayet||10||
śastreṇa samyaganu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā||10||
dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha||18||
piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mauśalī jaṭā||21||
jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ||22||
lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam||22||
mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavastuvarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ nepālī haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam||31||

lines: pṛṣṭhe kūrmatayā caturbhujatayā dormaṇḍale mandaraṃ ruddhvā kṣīrasamudramoṣadhibhṛtaṃ nirmathya niṣpāditaiḥ| ānītairamṛtairbhiṣaktamatayā yoṣittayā pāyitairdevānāmajarāmaratvamakarottasmai namo viṣṇave||1||
carake haricandrādyaiḥ suśrute jaijjaṭādibhiḥ| ṭīkākārairna nirṇātamiha hemādgiṇoditam|| 4||

deśabhraṃśabhayādvicālya layinaḥ snehaiḥ pratāpaiḥ paraṃ pradrāvya prasṛtān praveśya parito durgodaraṃ drāktataḥ| ūrdhvādhogati nirgamayya madanairdantyādibhirvidviṣo doṣānadraḍhi rāmarājyamagadaṅkāreṇa hemādriṇā|| 5||
hemādrirnāma rāmasya rājñaḥ śrīkaraṇeṣvadhi| nanūbhau bhagavanniṣṭhaṣāṅguṇyakaraṇeṣvadhi|| 6||
sarveṣāṃ dvīpavarṇāṇāṃ meruruttarataḥ sthitaḥ| tadastu sarvottaratā hemādrau dṛśyate yataḥ|| 7||
sevyā hemādriṭīkeyamāyurvedarasāyanam| āyurvedātmanāṃ puṃsāṃ nirdoṣatvam hi nānyathā||8||
aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṃ mukhyamanukte+aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahaḥ| tantrāntarāṇi coktāni vaiṣamye vivṛtāni ca||9||
vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ||6||
vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca||7||
koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdurmadhyo madhyaḥ syāttaiḥ samairapi||9||
tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo+anilaḥ||11||
pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam||11||
snigdhaḥ śīto gururmandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ||12||
yata evaṃ dehamanasī rogādhiṣṭhānatvena sthite, na kevalo deho nāpi kevalaṃ manaḥ||21||
bastirvireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu||26||
śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṅkare ca tato gadaḥ||32||
cikitsitaṃ jvare rakte kāse śvāse ca yakṣmaṇi||42||
vamau madātyaye+arśaḥsu, viśi dvau, dvau ca mūtrite||42||
bālopacāre tadvyādhau tadgrahe, dvau ca bhūtage||45||
janmāde+atha smṛtibhraṃśe, dvau dvau vartmasu sandhiṣu||46||
dṛktamoliṅganāśeṣu trayo, dvau dvau ca sarvage||46||
vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho+ajīrṇo ca taṃ tyajet||11||
tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ||13||
sukhaṃ ca na vinā dharmāttasmāddharmaparo bhavet||20||
naikaḥ sukhī, na sarvatra viśrabdho, na ca śaṅkitaḥ||27||
niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāyavān||33||
sarvathekṣeta nādityaṃ, na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet||39||
ācāryaḥ sarvaceṣṭāsu loka eva hi dhīmataḥ||45||
iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnu śrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dinacaryā nāma dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ||2||
ādānaṃ ca, tadādatte nṛṇāṃ pratidinaṃ balam||2||
tiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuko balino+atra rasāḥ kramāt||4||
saumyatvādatra somo hi balavān hīyate raviḥ||5||
śīte+agryaṃ vṛṣṭidharme+alpaṃ balaṃ madhyaṃ tu śeṣayoḥ||7||
niyuddhaṃ kuśalaiḥ sārdhaṃ pādāghātaṃ ca yuktitaḥ||10||
rasān snigdhān palaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ gauḍamacchasurāṃ surām||12||

a0 ra0-śiśiracaryāmāha-ayameveti| ayaṃ-hemantoktaḥ| svayuktyā nyūnādhikaprayoganiṣedhārthamevaśabdaḥ| viśeṣataḥ-atyabhyāsena| hi-yasmāt, tadā-tasminkāle, adhikaṃ śītam, ādānakālajaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca| cakārādvātakopabalakṣayau ca| yathoktaṃ khāraṇādina-"svabhāvaśaityādraukṣyācca vātakopādbalakṣayāt| vidhirviśeṣātsnigdhoṣṇaḥ śiśire haimanomataḥ||" iti| vātakopaśca tenaivoktaḥ-"sa vāyuḥ śiśire kopaṃ yātyevopacayaṃ kaphaḥ|" iti|
pratyahaṃ kṣīyate śleṣmā tena vāyuśca vardhate||27||
madyaṃ na peyaṃ, peyaṃ vā svalpaṃ, subahuvāri vā||29||
jaṅgamā iva padminyo haranti dayitāḥ klamam||41||
divyaṃ kaupaṃ śṛtaṃ cāmbho bhojanaṃ tvatidurdine||46||
taptānāṃ sañcitaṃ vṛṣṭau pittaṃ śaradi kupyati||49||
tiktaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca kṣudhito+annaṃ bhajellaghu||50||
ā0 raṃ0-tuṣārādīnniṣedhati-tuṣārakṣāreti| tuṣāroabadhyāyaḥ| kṣāro-yavakṣārādiḥ| sauhityaṃ-tṛptibhojanam| tīkṣṇamadyaṃ-tīvramadamadyam| purovātaḥ-pūrvadigvāyuḥ|
asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā tyāgaśīlanāt||3||
vātādeenāṃ vegānna dhārayet| sarvatra dvandvasamāsaḥ| kṣavaḥ- chikka| śramo- vyāyāmāyāsaḥ, tena śvāsaḥ śramaśvāsaḥ|
mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyate ghṛtam||6||
tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam||12||
śoṣe hidhmā ca, kāryo+atra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ||14||
sagulmā bāṣpatastatra svapno madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ||16||
nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati||22||
dhārayettu sadā vegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca||24||
yateta ca yathākālaṃ malānāṃ śodhanaṃ prati||25||
ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ||26||
ghanātyaye vārṣikamāśu samyak prāpnoti rogānṛtujānna jātu||35||
dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvā- nāptopasevī ca bhavatyarogaḥ||36||
iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogānu- tpādanīyo nāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ||4||
anārtavaṃ ca yaddivyamārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat||7||
nārikelodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu||19||
pariśeṣebhyo vargebhyaḥ prājyajanopayogitayopakāritvenājanmasātmyena prādhānyāt payaḥ sajñāsāmānyāt payasa iva jīvanādiguṇayogācca toyavargādanu kṣīravargaḥ prakramyate||20||
pīnase mūtrakṛcchre ca, rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade||31||
na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no mandamanyathā||32||
ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt||42||
kiñcitkālaṃ vidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ yāti yāntrikaḥ||44||
pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate||54||
tailaṃ svayonivattatra mukhyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca||55||
ākṣaṃ svādu himaṃ keśyaṃ guru pittānilāpaham||60||
tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghustīkṣṇā nihanti ca||68||
vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate||69||
mārdvīkaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram||72||
śimbīdhānyasya tu tadvyañjanattvena svalpopayogittvāt prāyeṇāpathyāttvāccāprādhanyaṃ, ityāha- atha śūkadhānyavargaḥ||1||
snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādudustridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ||7||
koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāhī sparśe śīto viṣāpahaḥ||13||
rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro viḍvātakṛdyavaḥ||13||
vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā||15||
kaṣāyaṃ svādu saṅgrāhi kaṭupākaṃ himaṃ laghu||17||
uṣṇastvacyo himaḥ sparśe keśyo balyastilo guruḥ||23||
vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī dīpanī hitā||29||
rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balyā rucipradā||35||
viṣṭambhi mūtralaṃ hṛdyaṃ yathādravyaguṇaṃ ca tat||36||
dhānā viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī lekhanī guruḥ||38||
na bhuktvā na dvijaiśchittvā saktūnadyānna vā bahūn||40||
vartako vartikā caiva tittiriḥ krakaraḥ śikhī||45||
tatra baddhamalāḥ śītā laghavo jāṅgalā hitāḥ||55||
dīpanaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ||56||
caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param||60||
evaṃ vargapañcakasya sāmānyaguṇānuktvā, apavādamāha- śītā mahāmṛgāsteṣu, kravyādaprasahāḥ punaḥ||62||
lāvarohitagodhaiṇāḥ sve sve varge varāḥ param||67||
māṃsaṃ sadyohataṃ śuddhaṃ vayaḥsthaṃ ca bhajet-----||68||
hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī||74||
tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit||78||

sāmānyaguṇānuktvā keṣāṃcidguṇakarmaviśeṣamāha- sa0-paṭolaṃ hṛdyādiguṇayuktam| muninā (?) tu tridoṣaśamanatvamuktam-"paṭolapatraṃ pittaghnaṃ vallī cāsya kaphāpahā| phalaṃ tridoṣaśamanaṃ mūlaṃ cāsya virecanam||" iti|
snigdhaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu bṛṃhaṇaṃ śukrakṛtparam||84||
jīvanī bṛṃhaṇī kaṇṭhyā gurvī vṛṣyā rasāyanam||86||
krauñcādanaṃ kaloḍyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru||92||
ālukāni ca sarvāṇi tathā sūpyāni lakṣmaṇam||94||
laghupatrā tu yā cillī sā vāstukasamā matā||96||
ārdrikā tiktamadhurā mūtralā na ca pittakṛt||109||
tīkṣṇo gṛañjanako grāhī pittināṃ hitakṛnna saḥ||113||
dīpanaḥ sūraṇo rucyaḥ kaphaghno viśado laghuḥ||113||
patre puṣpe phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt||114||
varā śākeṣu jīvantī sārṣapaṃ tvavaraṃ param||2||

phalānāmāhārakāle śākebhyo+alpopayogitvācchākavargādanantaraṃ phalavarga ucyate| kharanāde+apyuktam-"bhuktāvasāne phalaṃ bhujyate, iti phalavargo+abhidhīyate" ityāha---- sa0-phaleṣuttamā-phalottamā gostanīparyāyā drākṣā| sā vṛṣyādiguṇayuktā| sakaṣāyā-īṣatkaṣayā| anilādīn kṣayāntān hanti| udāvartaharatvaṃ carakamuninā+asyā uktam| tacca snigdhatvavṛṣyatvasṛṣṭaviṇmūtratvenehoktaprāyam| anyāsāṃ ca drākṣāṇāṃ guṇahīnatvaṃ deśādyanurodhāt kalpyam|
sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ grāhi rocanadīpanam||118||
urumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam||121||
phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam||122||
dīpanaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ bālaṃ, grāhyubhayaṃ ca tat||126||
svādvamlaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ca dvidhā pālevataṃ guru||135||
viṣyandi lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sṛṣṭamalaṃ mṛdu||143||
saindhavaṃ tatra sasvādu vṛṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tridoṣanut||144||
romakaṃ laghu, pāṃsūtthaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru||149||
dīpanī pācanī medhyā vayasaḥ sthāpanī param||154||
kaṣāyā madhurā pāke rūkṣā vilavaṇā laghu||153||
rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ kaphaghnaṃ maricaṃ laghu||161||
śleṣmalā svāduśītā+a+ardrā gurvī snigdhā ca pippalī||161||
sā śuṣkā viparītā+ataḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā rase kaṭuḥ||162||
nāgaraṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ grāhi hṛdyaṃ vibandhanut||163||

viṣe sthāvarajaṅgame| saktavo vātalā rūkṣāḥ pītāste tarpayantitu|| vinā+api copayogena maṇimantrādi kāryakṛt| āṛdrakājjāyate śuṇṭhī saṃskāreṇa laghīyasī|| laghubhyo+api hi saktubhyo guravaḥ siddhapiṇḍakāḥ| bhṛṣṭaḥ kṣuṇṇo+api pṛthuko raktaśālerlaghorguruḥ|| śāliḥ piṣṭo garīyastvaṃ godhūmādapi gacchati| laghupittaharā lājā vrīhito gurupittalāt|| saṅgrāhiṇo laghormudgāt kulmāṣo bhedano guruḥ| āmaṃ grāhitaraṃ takraṃ nāgarīkṛtamārdrakam|| guḍāttoyācca sutarāṃ mūtralaṃ guru pānakam| garīyo guḍadadhyuktaṃ rasālā cātiśukralā|| daṇḍābhimathanāddadhno guruṇaścātiśophadāt| anuddhṛtasnehamapi takraṃ śophaharaṃ laghu| sarpiḥ snigdhataraṃ hanti nārditaṃ navanītavat| cakṣuṣyo+api higodhūmastailapakvastu dṛṣṭihā| mūlakaṃ doṣajananaṃ siddhaṃ tu tadadoṣalam| uṣṇaṃ viṣībhavatyeva viṣaghnamapi mākṣikam| durbhājanasthā drākṣāmlā doṣalā ca prajāyate| ślakṣṇaśuṣkaghano lepaścandanasyāpi dāhakṛt|| tvaggatasyoṣmaṇo rodhācchītakṛttvanyathā+aguroḥ| medhyastilaḥ sparśaśīto+amedhyaṃ tailaṃ khalo+ahimaḥ|| tasyaiva śleṣmakāritvaṃ na tailasya khalasya vā| dadhnaḥ śvayathukāritvaṃ na takranavanītayoḥ|| bhūmisātmyaṃ dadhikṣīrakarīraṃ maruvāsiṣu| kṣārah prācyeṣu, matsyāstu saindhaveṣvaśmakeṣu tu|| tailāmlaṃ, kandamūlādi malaye, kauṅkaṇe punaḥ| peyā, mantha udīcyeṣu, godhūmo+avantibhūmiṣu| bāhlīkā bāhlavāścīnāḥ śūlīkā yavanāḥ śakāḥ| māṃsagodhūmamārdvīkaśastravaiśvānarocitāḥ|| dehasātmyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kasyacit| peyā yūṣo raso+anyasya godhūmo+anyasya śālayaḥ|| ahitairapi teṣāṃ ca tairevopahitaṃ hitam| annapānauṣadhaṃ doṣamātrākālādyapekṣayā|| sātmyaṃ hyāśu balaṃ dhatte nātidoṣaṃ ca bahvapi| sraṃsanaṃ sat payo gavyaṃ bhavati grāhi kasyacit|| mandāgnirbhavati prāyaḥ kaphavātottaro hime| viṣaghnenāpi payasā dehe+ahervarddhate viṣam|| sthūlasthavirabālādau vamanādi niṣidhyate| takramāmaṃ kaphaṃ koṣṭhe hanti kaṇṭhe karoti tu|| vātahṛttve+api mṛdvīkākharjūraṃ koṣṭhavātakṛt| nātipathyaḥ śikhī pathyaḥ śrotrasvaravayodṛśām|| dṛṣṭeḥ sparśahimaṃ dravyaṃ śrotrasyoṣṇaṃ tu pūjitam| payaḥ svādu saraṃ śītaṃ, viparītaṃ tato dadhi|| kālena jāyate tasmāt kṣīravacca punarghṛtam| payo dadhi ca vātaghnamajātaṃ vātalaṃ tu tat|| takraṃ grāhi kaṣāyāmlamamlameva tu bhedanam| dhātakīguḍatoyāni kāraṇaṃ madyaśuktayoḥ|| śīte na tu tadādyante snigdhāmlalavaṇā hitāḥ| udamanthadivāsvapnau grīṣmādanyatra garhitau|| samayoge+api gharmādyā vātādicayahetavaḥ| ṛtuṣvanyo raseṣvanyo raukṣyasnehabalakramaḥ|| rasāyanaṃ kākamācī sadyaḥ, paryuṣitā viṣam| mūlakaṃ doṣajidbālaṃ, viparītaṃ tu kandavat|| jvare peyā kaṣāyāśca sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ virecanam| ṣaḍahaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ yuñjyādvīkṣya doṣabalābalam|| chardihṛdrogagulmārte vamanaṃ ca cikitsite| niṣiddhamapi nirdiṣṭaṃ bastirarśasakuṣṭhinoḥ|| jvare tulyartudoṣatvaṃ pramehe tulyadūṣyatā| raktagulme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyātvahetavaḥ|| āścotanamabhiṣyande yuñjītordhvaṃ dinatrayāt| añjanaṃ pakvadoṣasya pratiśyāye ca nāvanam|| nātipravṛddhe timire śirāmokṣo vidhīyate| duṣṭāsrasambhave+apīṣṭo nāsrapitte śirāvyadhaḥ|| apathyaṃ pathyamapyannaṃ niśāyāṃ netrarogiṇām| ahitāḥ saktavaḥ śuṣkā hitāste tu pramehiṇaḥ| gulminaḥ kṣīradadhyādi hapuṣādiyutaṃ hitam| vātalaṃ vātakope+api varṣāsu madhu śasyate|| tadeva madyaṃ madyasya viṣasya tu viṣāntaram| ghṛtamānūpadeśotthaṃ hemante ca balādhikam|| ālasyagaurave rūpaṃ vātaje+api jvare puraḥ| svedairyāti śamaṃ dāhaḥ prāyo laśunapānajaḥ|| divāsvamājjarāṃ yāti bhuktamanyedyuradya na| koṣṭhe ruddho+agnikṛdvāyurmedasā+arśobhiragnihṛt|| duṣpānaṃ durjaraṃ sarpirdīpanaṃ ca payo+anyatha| sarpādiśavakothebhyāṃ vṛścikānāṃ samudbhavaḥ|| te taireva punardaṣṭāḥ sadyo jahati jīvitam| svayameva viṣaṃ tīvraṃ tān punarnātibāghate|| sarvāṅgavyāpi teśāṃ ca śukravat saṃsmṛtaṃ viṣam| tanmāṃsamupayogāya māṃsavarge ca paṭhyate|| chardighnī mākṣikāviṭ ca makṣikaiva tu vāmayet| kaphe laṅghanasādhye+api kartari jvaragulmayoḥ|| tulye+api deśakālādau laṅghanaṃ na samaṃ matam| sarvathā doṣajittakraṃ grahaṇyāṃ, doṣakṛdraṇe|| pīnasaśvāsakāsādau siddhameva praśasyate| ityete+anye ca bahavaḥ sūkṣmā durlabhahetukāḥ|| dharmā vicitrā bhāveṣu kiñcitteṣāṃ nidārśitam| diśā+anayā śeṣamapi svayamūheta buddhimān|| na śāstramātraśaraṇo na cānālocitāgamaḥ|" iti|
hīnā+atiriktā vikṛtā chhāyā dṛśyeta naiva vā||5||
nīlā rājī rase, tāmrā kṣīre, dadhani dṛśyate||7||
mrīyante makṣikāḥ prāśya kākaḥ kṣāmasvaro bhavet||14||

sarvagandhaiḥ samāyojya pacetpakve ca nikṣipet|| somarājīṃ sunandākhyāṃ saralāṃ gandhanākulīm| cāraṭīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca prokṣayettena tāṃ bhuvam|| sunandākhyā-gorocanā| cāraṭī-padmacāriṇī| saviṣaṃ virasaṃ toyaṃ koviṣṇaṃ rājibhiścitam| phenilaṃ guru vicchinnaṃ khagairanabhinanditam|| mṛtākulitamatsyaṃ ca sparśāttacchophakaṇḍumat| odanaḥ sādhitastena bhuktamātro vidahyāe|| vidagdhaḥ pacyate kṛcchrātpavko mūrcchājvarapradaḥ| darśayetsarvato nīlapītakarburalohitam|| tatra śigrvādimagadaṃ bhūmidoṣoditaṃ pibet| ajaśṛṅgīṃ viśālākhyāṃ viṣaghnīmuttamāraṇīm|| phaṇijjakaṃ prativiṣāṃ dagdhvā tadbhasma gālayet| bahuśo gālitaṃ tacca pācayettatra ca kṣipet|| kalkayetvā pratīvāpaṃ saralāṃ rajanīdvayam| elāmudīcyaṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ sunandāṃ bākucīmapi|| pātyante bindavastasmādyatra tannirviṣībhavet|| pāṭalāpāribhadrāśvakarṇasyāmāka śigrukān|| kalaśāntargatān dgdhvā prakṣipetsaviṣe+ambhasi| śīte gharmo himaścoṣṇe māruto viṣasaṃyutaḥ|| bhramamūrcchādikārī ca śigrvādistatra kiñcidāhārayennṛpaḥ|| dhanyaṃ sarvārthasiddhākhyaṃ pātmarakṣoviṣāpaham| paraṃ cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyaṃ śatrughnaṃ vakṣyate+añjanam|| atha śuklapakṣe puṇye+ahani puṣpapunarvasuhastacitrāmṛgaśiraḥ pūrvoktaṃ tryūṣaṇādiṃ ca snānīye+ambhasi yojayet| kvātho+athavā+arkakusumaśvetāpāmārgasarṣapaiḥ|| sadadhyājyaḥ kṛto yuktaiḥ kāmātānākulīyakaiḥ| kalko vā candanakṣīripalāśadrumavalkalaiḥ|| mūrvailavālusurasānākulītandulīyakaiḥ| kvāthaḥ sarvodakāryeṣu kākamācīyutairhitaḥ|| rocanāpatranepālīkuṅkumaistilakaṃ vahan| viṣairna bādhyate syāñca nārīnaranṛpapriyaḥ|| cūrṇairhadrāmañjiṣṭhākiṇihīkaṇanimbajaiḥ|| digdhaṃ nirviṣatāmeti gātramityāha gautamaḥ|| nasyapānāsānālepairyuñjyātsañjīvanādikān| agadān viṣajagdhasya tīkṣṇāni damanāni ca|| agadān-viṣatantroktān| pippalīmadhukakṣaudraśarkarekṣurasaiḥ saha| virecanaṃ śirāmokṣaṃ praptaṃ visrāvaṇaṃ yadi|| hradayāvaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ prāgevāmitramadhyagaḥ| pibeddhṛtamajeyākhyamamṛtaṃ vā+apyabhuktavān|| ajeyāmṛte-viṣatantrokte| sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ dadhi kṣīramantataḥ śītalaṃ jalam|| antataḥ-ante sarvābhāve, ata eva pūrveṣu pūrvābhāve paramita labhyate| sitāmadhukapālindīkalkavanmāṃsamiṣyate|| godhāhariṇababhrūṇāṃ sakaṇāśuṇṭhi pārṣattam| sanāgaraṃ sātiviṣaṃ śikhinaḥ sasitophalam|| suśītāḥ saghṛtāścaiṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ kalpitā rasāḥ| ithyaṃ viṣagarādibhyo rakṣedvaidyo nareśvaram| syāttaduccheda ucchedaḥ prajānāṃ sarvakarmaṇām|| ājñādhairyakṣamātyāgā mānuṣatve+apyamānuṣāḥ| yadrājñaḥ karmabhistasmādārādhyo+asāvatīndriyaiḥ|| yatra sākṣānnṛpastatra nijñātaḥ praviśedbhiṣak| na sammato+apyanucitaṃ yānasthānāsanaṃ bhajet|| ucitaṃ purato rājñastiṣṭhedvākyaṃ ca nākṣipet| ahīnakālaṃ rājārthaṃ, svārthaṃ priyahitaiḥ saha|| deśe kāle parārthaṃ ca vadeddharmārthasaṃhitam| nānuśiṣyādapṛcchantaṃ mahadetaddhi sāhasam|| nācaredahitenainaṃ mūlocchedakaraṃ hi tat| anukūlaṃ hitaṃ vācyamahitādvārayenmithaḥ|| udāraiḥ sāntvathanvākyairdoṣaścettadupekṣayā| tūṣṇīṃ vā prativākye syādvarjayeddveṣyasaṅkathām|| vipaścidapyacittajño bālaśo+api tu bhāvavit| atipriyo+api dveṣyo+api yātyāśu viparītatām|| nivedya rājñe kurvīta kāryāṇi sulaghūnyapi| na yāyānna ciraṃ tiṣṭhetkośasthānāvarodhayoḥ|| svalpe+api darśaye ttuṣṭiṃ lābhe+anuddhatamānasaḥ| mithaḥ kathanamanyena kaulīnaṃ dvandvavāditām|| vastrādi rājñaḥ saddaśaṃ rājalīlāṃ ca varjayet| dattaṃ yattu nṛpeṇaiva prasṛṣṭe viṇmūtre hṛdi suvimale doṣe svapathage viśuddhe codgāre kṣudupagamane vāte+anusarati||55||
